clips.title: The story
paras: At a farmhouse in Silverpine, Deathstalker Rane Yorick and her brother Quinn are cut off from the Sepulcher. Sent to scout the northern farms, they must get word to High Executor Hadrec.

Across Lordaeron, the Deathstalkers are Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's eyes, ears, and blades. Agents like Rane Yorick watch the wilds from hidden posts for threats to Forsaken rule. Rane and her brother Quinn were sent to scout northern Silverpine Forest. Feral dangers closed around them, turning their covert work into a fight to survive.
